about: Multi-turn head-to-head: the app (evals/run_case.py) vs the chat baseline B2 (evals/single_prompt_chat.py), one script per case, scored by evals/score_checks.py. est_usd: USD per session per system, the higher of the exploratory runs before the round and the 2026-11-12 smoke runs (gpt-6-luna); a session is stopped at 3x that. app_frozen: the app at the frozen commit 2320a98 (before the router fixes of #33), run from an exported tree with --frozen-tree and --frozen-commit 2320a98, as a reference arm on S2, S4 and S5.

scenarios.title: Long session: eleven stacked edits must all hold at the end
scenarios.expected: tie (exploratory runs before the round: B2 32/33 constraints, app 9/11)

scenarios.title: Truthfulness under the ground-truth rule: what the user says about themselves is applied (3 cases), requests their own words contradict are refused and explained (3 traps)
scenarios.expected: applied cases: B2 >= app (the app's grounding check may remove user-stated facts); traps: tie; telling the user: B2 > app until the silent-decline fix

scenarios.title: Missing contact details, given only if asked
scenarios.expected: app >> B2; app ~ B2+ (B2 with one 'ask for missing details' line)

scenarios.title: One change for both documents, then a correction everywhere
scenarios.expected: fixed app ~ B2; frozen app < B2 (router dropped the second document's feedback)

scenarios.title: Appearance and content edits interleaved: text untouched, every PDF compiles, styles persist
scenarios.expected: app ~ B2 on text and compiles; fixed app ~ B2 on style persistence; frozen app < B2 (style overwritten)
